text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While on a walk one day, I happen to
see a
familiar face.

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff! B-bakushin! Bakushiiiin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The one and only! Hello! We're training
for her
next Uma Kids Footrace Meet!
choice_data_list: あの子は……バクシンオーの妹さん？
choice_data_list_en: Is that girl... Bakushin O's little sister?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think back to when I watched the
Footrace Meet
the other day, recalling
that Sakura Bakushin O's
sister didn't
place as high as she'd hoped.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Finishing tenth really stuck with her.
She's been
training hard ever since.
Chasing the Bakushin, in
her words.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm friends with Bakushin O—we're
in the
same club.
choice_data_list: チヨノオーもサポートしているんだな
チヨノオーもサポートしているんだね
choice_data_list_en: Chiyono O is supporting them too, huh.
Chiyono O is supporting them too, right.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That's how I got to know her sister. We
cook
together sometimes, and she
makes the most
amazing sweets! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Still, something's off. She usually
runs
faster than this.

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna Bakushin... and become the
ultimate
racer... just like my sister!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Her form?! I see! I see?!
choice_data_list: たしかに、フォームがぎこちないような
choice_data_list_en: True, your form does seem a bit awkward.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Would you?! In that case, since we're
about to
break for lunch, I'd like your
advice about her
regimen...
choice_data_list: よければトレーニングに付き合おうか？
choice_data_list_en: If you'd like, want me to join you for training?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Stomachs, full! Brains, picked! Time to
get back
to train—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, no, hold that thought! Check out
that
sign! "Face our fast-paced, full-on
food
challenge"?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fast-paced? That's the essence of
Bakushin! As a
big sister, I've gotta step
up and set a shining
example!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
T-then I'd better Bakushin with you, Sis!
Bakushin!
choice_data_list: 『いまだ達成者なし』って書いてあるぞ！？
『いまだ達成者なし』って書いてあるよ！？
choice_data_list_en: It says 'No one has ever cleared this' here?!
It says 'No one has ever cleared this' here?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
A-are you sure about this?! Even a
grown-up
Umamusume couldn't finish
that much!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Don't listen to her! Let us rise to the
challenge,
my dear sister! Our combined
Bakushin will ensure
victory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their combined Bakushin did not ensure
victory.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Heh... It was a formidable opponent. But I won't stay down. Once I power up into my second and third forms, I'll go back for a rematch. Burp.

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
Eh-hehe... I couldn't even finish half of
what you
managed...

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
My time's not improving either. It's hard
to
Bakushin...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While Sakura Bakushin O seems fine, her
little
sister's glum mood starts to worry
me. I rack my
brain for a way to cheer
her up.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um... I think more food is the last thing
we need
right now...
choice_data_list: おっ！美味しそうなお菓子が売ってるぞ！
あっ！美味しそうなお菓子が売ってるよ！
choice_data_list_en: Oh! They're selling some delicious-looking sweets!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My suggestion falls flat.

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but... don't they remind you of the
sweets we
made that one time, Big Sis?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Now that takes me back! You
were such a
good teacher that it
convinced me you'd grow up
to be a
model class rep!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You said it! But she's got more than just
teaching
up her sleeve! Cleaning,
laundry, sewing,
handicrafts—she can do
it all!
choice_data_list: さすがバクシンオーの妹さんだな
さすがバクシンオーの妹さんだね
choice_data_list_en: That's Bakushin O's little sister for you.
That's Bakushin O's little sister for you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's like everything is a piece of cake for

her—even the stuff I don't excel at!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
Aw, Big Sis! Delicate work's really not
your strong
suit, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: AH!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I've got it! I know exactly what my little
sister
needs!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text: You do? What is it?! Tell me, tell me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In due time, sister of mine. But there's
something I
must prepare first—alone!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, we're done for today! Class
dismissed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for understanding! Now if you'll
excuse
me, I'm off to get started!
choice_data_list: わかった、応援してるよ
準備、手伝わせてほしい！
choice_data_list_en: Got it. I'm rooting for you.
Please let me help with the preparations!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
There she goes... You think she'll really
be okay
alone?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The rest of us disperse, all of us
wondering what
Sakura Bakushin O
could be up to.
choice_data_list: バクシンオーを信じよう

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No, I must decline! That's one thing I
won't budge
on!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No matter what, I have to do this by
myself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It appears that for the sake of her sister's

improvement, Sakura Bakushin O must

accomplish this mission of hers alone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some time later, I hear word that her
sister did
quite well in a recent
competition.
